'''Oops the Fish''' is a {{Special}} [[Collectable Items|Collectable]] item obtained from the Main lobby during a Summer event.

== Obtaining ==
You must have fished the Egg the Fish item in the Main Lobby during the Summer event, and collected the special item from Jerry on SkyBlock.

== Trivia ==
*Oops the Fish was the first [[:Category:The Fish|fish]] obtainable by fishing in the Main Lobby.
* Unlike other [[Fish Family]] items, '''Oops the Fish''' cannot be shown to {{NPCSprite|Coral}} to obtain rewards.
